title: Starship Flight 14 coming soon, but double catch on Flight 15? - The Flame Trench

author: NASASpaceflight
description:
SpaceX is winding down Falcon 9 Starlink flights from Florida as Starship infrastructure ramps up at Roberts Road and SLC-37, with Gigabay outfitting, launch mount assembly, Project Ignition ship test site plans, and LC-39A chopstick and tank farm work advancing toward Florida Starship operations.

Blue Origin continues LC-36 repairs after the May anomaly, expands Rocket Park production and the MILA/Stennis test path for New Glenn, and progresses LC-36B, the Vertical Integration Facility, and a new payload processing site while holding Cidco Road. Relativity is finishing LC-16 systems and Terran R qualification ahead of Stennis hot fires and Project Forge expansion; Stoke’s LC-14 sits ready as Nova hardware matures in Washington.

ULA prepares Vulcan’s return with LEO Centaur, MLP-2, and VIF-A, and NASA has begun Artemis III SLS stacking in the VAB with Core Stage engine work and Artemis IV hardware arriving.

This NSF Space Coast flyover update features Ryan and Alex covering Kennedy
